title: Armour
description: armor.json: suits of armour (a shield isn't one: a character with a shield gets +2 AC). The kind caps the DEX bonus (none and light: all of it, medium: +2, heavy: none, and initiative -2). Documentation only: the C# loader (Tactics.Logic PackLoader and Validation) is the authority and also checks meaning (spec §4.10).

baseAc.description: The AC before the DEX bonus.
